messages.text:
I’ve set up a combined refund proposal for **R$389.80** for the tin and straw set. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat message won’t confirm it. The refund still needs staff approval [refund-policy/v2/approval].

It doesn’t mean your bank will pay you immediately. In this demo, a receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger; it is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t give a date for money to appear on your card [refund-policy/v2/payout].
